title: Publish a video / blog / text to social platforms
description:
Distribute content to the social platforms connected to your account. Provide
**exactly one** of `topic_id` (an existing WideCast video/blog), `text`
(arbitrary post), or `video_url` (an external video FILE url, needs `title`).
`platforms` defaults to **all connected**. **⚠ Running posts PUBLICLY and
charges 1 credit.** The response carries the upstream `request_ids` — poll
`GET /v1/status/{request_id}` for per-platform post URLs.

use_cases.title: 📣 Publish an existing WideCast video/blog
use_cases.description: Pass the `topic_id` from /v1/create_video or /v1/create_content. WideCast auto-detects article vs video (a video must be rendered first). Omit `platforms` to post to all connected.

use_cases.title: ✍️ Post arbitrary text
use_cases.description: Post text you provide directly (not from a WideCast topic) to all connected text platforms.

use_cases.title: 🎬 Post an external video URL
